name: ./AGNT Protocol
description: Agent-native DeFi toolkit — 56+ MCP tools for autonomous swaps, bridges, lending, perps, yield, and market intelligence across Tempo, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and more.

authentication.note: All tools are currently free. MPP (Machine Payment Protocol) gating available for premium tiers.

skills.name: Token Swap
skills.description: Swap tokens across Tempo DEX, Uniswap V3, PancakeSwap, or via smart routing that auto-discovers the best pool.
examples: Swap 100 USDC for ETH on Tempo
Find and swap the best pool for PEPE

skills.name: Cross-Chain Bridge
skills.description: Bridge tokens between chains via Stargate, Relay, deBridge, or Jumper/LiFi aggregator.
examples: Bridge 500 USDC from Ethereum to Arbitrum
Get a quote for bridging ETH to Base

skills.name: Lending & Borrowing
skills.description: Supply/withdraw assets on Aave V3 and Morpho optimized vaults across multiple chains.
examples: Supply 1000 USDC to Aave on Ethereum

skills.name: Perpetual Trading
skills.description: Trade perpetual futures on Hyperliquid: place orders, set leverage, manage positions.
examples: Open a 5x long on BTC with 1000 USDC

skills.name: Yield & Staking
skills.description: Liquid staking via Lido, restaking on EigenLayer, yield tokenization on Pendle, Ethena sUSDe, and Ondo USDY.
examples: Show Pendle markets sorted by APY

skills.name: Market Intelligence
skills.description: Real-time prices, charts, funding rates, gas fees, whale tracking, token security, sentiment, and DEX pool discovery.

skills.name: Automated Strategies
skills.description: DCA strategies, price alerts, copy trading, backtesting, and composable multi-step strategies.
examples: Set up a DCA buying 50 USDC of ETH every day
Alert me when BTC goes above 100k

skills.name: Prediction Markets
skills.description: Browse, analyze, and trade on Polymarket prediction markets.
